title: BLOCKING: confirm open/PD-only buildability and output-license compatibility for the Cyrillic ↔ Latin scheme
context: Before any scheme data may be authored, the maintainer/license reviewer must confirm in writing that (a) the mapping can be built entirely from open/PD sources or re-derived without copying any copyrighted table, and (b) the output license (CC-BY-4.0 for data, MIT for code) is compatible with every source used. This is a hard pre-authoring gate — not an open question — and scheme-cyrl-001 MUST NOT start until this task is delivered. ISO/DIN/ALA-LC tables are copyrighted and must never be copied; conformance may only be cited.
objective: Confirm and record in writing, on the provenance allow-list entries and in a short license-gate document, that the planned Cyrillic ↔ Latin scheme (ISO 9 System A–conformant) can be built entirely from the open/PD sources on the allow-list (UNGEGN, BGN/PCGN, Unicode CLDR/ICU, open corpora), without copying any copyrighted table, and that CC-BY-4.0 (data) and MIT (code) are compatible with every source license used.
acceptanceCriteria: A license-gate document (docs/license-gates/cyrl-latn.md or equivalent) records the written confirmation: (a) the Cyrillic ↔ Latin mapping can be built from open/PD sources on the allow-list without copying any copyrighted table, and (b) CC-BY-4.0 data / MIT code output licenses are compatible with all sources used
Each allow-list source used for scheme-cyrl-001 has verifiedBy and verifiedDate populated on the provenance allow-list
ISO 9, DIN 31635, and any other copyrighted standards that will be cited (not copied) are explicitly recorded as cite-only references with an excludedReason on the allow-list
If either confirmation (a) or (b) cannot be made, an alternative open-buildable scheme is identified or the scheme is formally deferred, and that decision is recorded
scheme-cyrl-001 is explicitly unblocked (or blocked with a documented reason) by the conclusion of this task
resources: PLAN.md — Data, licensing & compliance section; Risks & mitigations
tasks/open-transliteration-provenance-001.json — the allow-list this task depends on
UNGEGN / UN romanization systems for geographical names (verify per-document reuse terms)
BGN/PCGN romanization systems (US-gov / Crown; verify per document)
Unicode CLDR / ICU transform data (Unicode License)
output: docs/license-gates/cyrl-latn.md (license-gate written confirmation) and updated provenance allow-list entries with verifiedBy/verifiedDate populated for all Cyrillic scheme sources
